latent_ratings_divergence_cell_tilt_open.classification_evidence: Interval spans both signs by a wide margin at 187 games, reliability is nonzero, and no positive control was run at this cell size. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_divergence_cell_tilt_open.description: Predeclared cell: the 187 of 456 window games where at least one team's expected lineup is furthest from its own full-strength rated lineup (max absolute divergence at or above the 2017-2019 75th percentile, C=0.013312). Lineup-divergence tilt inside the cell -0.535 accuracy points vs -0.372 outside it - the cell did not separate (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.7).
latent_ratings_divergence_cell_tilt_open.plain_summary: Looking only at the games where one team is unusually far from having its best lineup available - the situation where player ratings should help most - the lean did no better there than anywhere else.

latent_ratings_divergence_tilt_brier.classification_evidence: Probability_positive is above 0.5 and the interval spans both signs, so no wrong sign; reliability is nonzero; the positive control was far larger than this effect, so no positive_control_bound. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_divergence_tilt_brier.description: Brier read of the lineup-divergence tilt under the predeclared mirror mapping, rotation window [2020,2021], active model d49194e04945a5e5: +0.001555, week-blocked 95% [-0.006785, +0.009274], probability_positive 0.667 - the one reading in this look that leans toward the candidate (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.6).
latent_ratings_divergence_tilt_brier.plain_summary: Judging the health-gap lean by how honest its stated confidence would have been rather than by wins and losses, it comes out slightly ahead.

latent_ratings_divergence_tilt_opener.classification_evidence: No admissible closing ground: the week-blocked interval reaches +3.254 so there is no resolved wrong sign; split-half reliability is +0.174/+0.154, not zero; the positive control proved detection at +11.623 points, far above the scale in dispute, so no positive_control_bound. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_divergence_tilt_opener.description: On-production opener screen, rotation window [2020,2021], active model d49194e04945a5e5: production's served opener pick plus a tilt toward the side whose expected lineup is less degraded relative to its own full-strength rated lineup, at the predeclared 2017-2019 75th-percentile margin (M2=0.012329). 165 eligible games, 86 picks changed, 53.29% baseline vs 52.85% candidate; 2020 +4.545, 2021 -5.085. Observed delta sits at the 83rd percentile of its own 200-draw within-week permutation null (centre -1.986) (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.6).
latent_ratings_divergence_tilt_opener.plain_summary: Leaning the pick toward whichever team is closest to having its full healthy lineup available cost about half a point of accuracy over 2020-2021, but it did better than a coin-flip version of the same rule and was clearly positive in 2020.

latent_ratings_expected_lineup_cell_tilt.classification_evidence: Interval spans both signs at 187 games, reliability is nonzero, no positive control at this cell size. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_expected_lineup_cell_tilt.description: Same predeclared 187-game cell, expected-lineup rating tilt instead of the divergence tilt: -1.070 accuracy points inside the cell vs -1.115 outside it (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.7).
latent_ratings_expected_lineup_cell_tilt.plain_summary: The lineup-rating lean, restricted to games where one team is unusually short of its best available lineup, performed the same as it did on every other game.

latent_ratings_expected_lineup_tilt_brie.classification_evidence: Interval spans both signs, reliability is nonzero, and the positive control resolved only a +0.0168 Brier gain, so none of the three admissible grounds applies. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_expected_lineup_tilt_brie.description: Brier read of the expected-lineup rating tilt under the predeclared mirror mapping (flipped games take 1-p, others keep p), rotation window [2020,2021], active model d49194e04945a5e5 (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.5).
latent_ratings_expected_lineup_tilt_brie.plain_summary: Measuring the same lineup-rating lean by how well-calibrated the published confidence would have been, rather than by wins and losses: no detectable difference either way.

latent_ratings_expected_lineup_tilt_open.classification_evidence: No admissible closing ground: the week-blocked interval reaches +2.298 so there is no resolved wrong sign; split-half reliability is +0.174 and +0.154, not zero; the positive control proved detection at +11.623 points, not at the ~1-point scale in dispute, so no positive_control_bound. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_expected_lineup_tilt_open.description: On-production opener screen, rotation window [2020,2021], active model d49194e04945a5e5: production's served opener pick plus a tilt toward the side whose expected-lineup RAPM sum leads by the predeclared 2017-2019 75th-percentile margin (M1=0.056158). 203 eligible games, 81 picks changed, 53.29% baseline vs 52.19% candidate. Observed delta sits at the 69th percentile of its own 200-draw within-week permutation null, whose centre is -1.726 because any tilt at this flip rate costs accuracy by arithmetic (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.5).
latent_ratings_expected_lineup_tilt_open.plain_summary: Leaning the pick toward the team whose expected starting lineup grades out better than the other side's did not improve the picks on 2020-2021 - the spread already knows most of what player ratings know.

latent_ratings_player_defense_reliabilit.classification_evidence: Reliability is positive and clearly nonzero, so no_split_half_reliability is not an admissible ground; no wrong sign and no positive control bounds a correlation of this size. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_player_defense_reliabilit.description: Odd-vs-even-season split-half of the season-lagged defensive RAPM player coefficient: 808 players with 500+ defensive participation plays in both halves, Pearson +0.154, Spearman-Brown +0.268 (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.2).
latent_ratings_player_defense_reliabilit.plain_summary: Same check on the defensive side of the player ratings: odd and even seasons agree modestly, so the defensive ratings are real but noisy.

latent_ratings_player_offense_reliabilit.classification_evidence: Reliability is positive and clearly nonzero, so no_split_half_reliability is not an admissible ground; no wrong sign and no positive control bounds a correlation of this size. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_player_offense_reliabilit.description: Odd-vs-even-season split-half of the season-lagged offensive RAPM player coefficient: 760 players with 500+ offensive participation plays in both halves, Pearson +0.174, Spearman-Brown +0.296 (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.2).
latent_ratings_player_offense_reliabilit.plain_summary: Rating each player from past seasons and then checking whether the odd-numbered seasons agree with the even-numbered ones: they agree modestly, so the offensive player ratings are real but noisy.

latent_ratings_tilt_positive_control.classification_evidence: A leaked control is not a research finding and closes nothing; recorded so the bound it does and does not establish is on the record. unresolved_below_power.
latent_ratings_tilt_positive_control.description: Deliberate-leak instrument check for the on-production tilt harness: the tilt feature replaced by the realized opener ATS margin at the same 75th-percentile threshold rule. 53 picks changed, all 53 wrong-to-right, +11.623 accuracy points, week-blocked 95% [+8.171, +15.066]. Proves the harness detects an effect of that size; it does not bound the ~1-point scale the real screen disputes (docs/latent_ratings_on_production.md section 8.4).
latent_ratings_tilt_positive_control.plain_summary: A rigged check that feeds the rule the actual game result: it correctly flipped every pick it touched, confirming the measuring setup is not blind.
